# Regression test for the textarea value-update fix.
#
# textarea(value=expr) and input(value=expr) must:
#   1. SetText with the value at BuildUI time (not just for bindTarget binds)
#   2. Register a reactive updater so doRefresh() re-syncs the entry text
#      when any var the value depends on changes
#
# Before the fix, the constructor allocated `widget.NewMultiLineEntry()` and
# stopped — read-only textareas rendered empty and never updated when the
# source var changed. See DESIGN/08-sngl-gaps.md [SNGL-TEXTAREA-NO-VALUE-UPDATE]
# in the jira-ui repo for the original repro.

sngl compile --platform=fyne --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# Init: SetText is emitted at BuildUI time for the textarea's value.
grep 'm\.entry0\.SetText\(fmt\.Sprint\(m\.content\)\)' out/model.go

# Reactive updater is registered.
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) updateEntry0\(\)' out/model.go

# updateEntry0 is wired into doRefresh.
grep 'm\.updateEntry0\(\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output {
    go { fyne }
}

component main {
    var content = "initial value"

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            textarea(value=content, rows=4)
            button(text="set", @click { content = "after click" })
        }
    }
}
